Definition: Integration of company registration, business licensing, tax compliance, regulatory compliance data
Comments: ZIDA (Zimbabwe Investment and Development Agency) provides online company registration. Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC) has digital services. ZimConnect portal includes business registration. Partially digitized but not fully interoperable across systems.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: National ICT Policy 2022-2027 provides policy framework. POTRAZ regulations on data protection (January 2026). No specific law mandating cross-government data sharing or interoperability confirmed. UNCTAD 2025 recommends full interoperability legislation. Legislation under development.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Smart Zimbabwe 2030 Master Plan has 3 pillars (Policy/Regulation/Standards, Secure Infrastructure, Skills Development) with phased rollout. National ICT Policy 2022-2027. National Digital Roadmap 2026-2030 announced November 2025. Interoperability mentioned in broader strategy but no comprehensive dedicated data exchange strategy.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: ZimConnect e-services portal exists but no unified national data exchange/interoperability platform operational. UNCTAD eTrade Readiness Assessment 2025 explicitly states 'siloism of government departments and systems is preventing seamless data exchange.' World Bank Digital Economy Diagnostic: 'lack of interoperability limits collaboration and data sharing.' EGDI 2024: 149th/193, score 0.4481, below global average.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: UNCTAD 2025 notes siloism even at national level prevents seamless data exchange. ZimConnect is primarily a national portal. No evidence of sub-national government (provincial/local) participation in data exchange. National level only.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Zimbabwe internet penetration approximately 38.4% with significant urban-rural divide. Harare and Bulawayo urban centers have adequate connectivity; rural areas very limited. National Broadband Plan 2020-2030 (launched March 2024) aims to address this but implementation early. Data exchange services primarily urban.
